answer: A split-tally bond blocks bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits and splits a yarrow tally, sealing one half at the forge. A tide auditor draws half the tallies per epoch and demands the match in the tide window; missing or borrowed halves burn bonds. Carving costs 36, then 36+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked, vs 40,000 pool. Rented tallies fail: one serial twice voids both. Honest agents pay 36 once and keep the bond.
